title: Thermo Fisher Scientific Tomo Software: Integrated Multigrid Data Acquisition and Live Reconstruction
content: The acquisition and processing of data represent substantial bottlenecks for researchers employing cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET), thereby diminishing the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the workflow. This workflow necessitates considerable expertise and is inherently time-intensive, often culminating in suboptimal yield. To enhance accessibility and streamline this complex workflow, we have developed an integrated software suite that combines Thermo Scientific Tomography 5 acquisition software with Thermo Scientific Tomo Live processing software and capabilities for data visualization and curation via CryoFlowTM, our platform for data integration. Furthermore, we have augmented this suite with a novel scheduling feature, Tomo Multigrid. Our solution automates numerous tasks traditionally executed manually, thereby ensuring consistent data quality and reproducibility.
